## Problem / motivation

analysis workflow behind it?

## Proposed capability

What should the tool do? Which surface — CLI, MCP, or the HTML portal?

## Provenance expectations

`INTERPRETATION`)? What must stay local / never be committed?

## Alternatives considered

Anything you've tried or ruled out.
